content: Nihqe Paul sinmuy amumi paṅqawu: Tahtaqtu, isinomu, námatu, nu yahsatniqwhaqam umutpik nēṅem hin lavayhtiniqw kurs uma inumi tūqayyuṅwni.
(Noqw pam pumuy amumi Hebrew‐sinmuy amuhkwa yuaaykuqw, puma nanaptaqe pahsat pu pas qa hiṅqaqwa; noqw pam paṅqawu).

Nu pas antsa Jew‐sino; nihqe nu Ciliciat ep wuhkokitsokit Tarsus ep tihtiwa. Nīk̇aṅw nu yep kīve Gamaliel ahpiy itanamuy tutavoyamuy pas aṅhqe qatsqat tutuqayi; nihqe nu God eṅem pas qaatsay’ta, uma pu’ it tāwat ep panyuṅqat pan’i.
Nihqe nu it yaṅ pöhut aṅ hinwisqamuy pas qa yesniqat ōviy tahtaqtuy pu momoymuy okiwsahsanqe, somlawk̇aṅw sivikimi taṅatima.

Noqw God awwat mohpeq moṅwi sohsokmuy wukw’ayamuy amumum inumi navoti’ta; pu nu piw pumuy amuṅaqw itahsinmuy amumi tutuvenit ömahtaqe, Damascus aqw’a, nu Jesus aw tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy pepeq yesqamuy sivintoyne’, pumuy somhtat, Jerusalem aqw tsamniqee.
Paul Tells of His Conversion
Noqw nu paṅsoqnīk̇aṅw, tāwanasavehaqam Damascus aw hayiṅwnaqw, ōṅaqw inunan’ik qaan’ewakw suhtalawva.
Noqw nu tutskwami posqe, hakiy tönayat navotq, inumi paṅqawu: Saul, Saul, ya um hinoqw nuy okiwsahsana?
Noqw nu lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Ya um hak’i Tutuyqawhqa? Noqw pam inumi paṅqawu: Nu Nazareth aṅqw Jesus; pi um nuy hapi okiwsahsana.
Noqw ima inumumyaqam tālat tutwaqe, tsātsawna; nīk̇aṅw puma hakiy inumi hiṅqawhqat tönayat qa nanapta.
Noqw nu paṅqawu: Noqw nu hinhtini, Tutuyqawhqa? Noqw Tutuyqawhqa inumi paṅqawu: Um wunuptut Damascus awni. Noqw ason pep um hihta tumaltaniqat uṅem yukiwtaqat suhk̇a uṅ sohsok āawnani.
Noqw pas tāla a’nö talq, ivosiy qatālawvaqw, ōviy ima inumumyaqam imay ṅuy’wisk̇aṅw Damascus aw nuy wikya.
Noqw hak hin tutaptiwhqat an God pas k̇aptsi’taqa Ananias sohsokmuy Jew‐sinmuy pep ki’yuṅqamuy amuhpiy aw lomanavoti
Inumi pítuhqe wunuk̇aṅw inumi paṅqawu: Itupko Saul, uhvosiy tālawnaa. Noqw nu pahsat pay ivosiy tālawna.
Noqw pam paṅqawu: Itanamuy aw yantaqaam God uṅ namorstaqe Tiy pas súantaqat ūmi mātaknaqw, um put moayat aṅqw lavayit navota, um put tunatyayat mātsi’taniqe ōviy’o.
Pi um hin yórikqey, pu navotqey sohsokmuy sinmuy amumi put eṅem tuawi’tani.
Taay, um hinoqw sȫwuu? Um wunupte’, kūyit akw tuvoylatini; nen Tutuyqawhqat natṅwaniyat aw taqa’naṅway’k̇aṅw, uhqaanhtipuy ayo pāhomni.
Paul’s Call to Preach to the Gentiles
Noqw ura nu piw Jerusalem ep pítuhqe God kīyat ep nāwaknak̇aṅw, tuawyori;
Nihqe Jesus tuwaqw, pam inumi paṅqawu: Písoqtii, nen um Jerusalem aṅqw īts ahpiyni, taq puma uṅ hin nuy tuawi’taqat soon kwusuyani.
Noqw nu paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, puma navoti’yuṅqw, nu ura as ūmi tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy sivikimi taṅatinuma, pu ahsupoq tsotsvalkiva pumuy wuvahtinuma.
Pu uṅ tuawi’taqat Stephen uṅwáat munvaniwhq, nu nuhtum aqlap wunuk̇aṅw, nīnantotaqamuy súamun unaṅwti; nihqe nu nīnantotaqamuy yuwsiyamuy tūwala.
Noqw pam inumi paṅqawu: Um ahpiyni, taq nu uṅ yaṅqw yāvoqhaqami imuy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amumi távini.
Noqw puma it lavayit aw pahsavo put aw tūqayyuṅwt, pu sáakmaqe paṅqaqwa: Tūvayaa! Nīnayaa! Pay pi put qa qatuqw lolmani.
Noqw puma kwanonotik̇ahk̇anw, yuwsiy akw savinumyak̇aṅw qöat ōmiq tsaltoynaya.
Noqw pahsat pu solāwamoṅwi put solāwakimi panayaniqat solāwamuy amumi paṅqawu. Uma put wuvahtotat, pās tūviṅtotani. Noqw hinoqw sinom pas panhaqam put ehpewi hiṅqaqwaqat itam nanaptani, amumi kita.
Noqw puma put tuyqat akw sohsomyaqw, Paul solāwamoṅwit pep wúnuhqat aw paṅqawu: Ya pay um hakiy Roman‐sinot qa tūviwtaqat wuvahtaniqw pay pam súanta?
Noqw solāwamoṅwi put navotqe ahpiynihqe mohpeq solāwamoṅwit aw paṅqawu: Um hintsakqey ep tunatyaltini, taq kurs i’ Roman‐sino.
Pahsat pu mohpeq solāwamoṅwi pítuhqe put aw paṅqawu: Kurs nuy āawnaa, ya um Roman‐sino? Noqw pam paṅqawu: Owí.
Noqw mohpeq solāwamoṅwi paṅqawu: Nu a’nö sisvit, Rome aqw sinoti. Noqw Paul paṅqawu: Noqw pi nu pay pas pamnīk̇aṅw tihtiwa.
Pahsat pay ima as put aw hepyaniqam ahpiyya. Noqw pam Roman‐sínonihqat mohpeq solāwamoṅwi navotqe tusita, put somqe ōviy’o.
Paul before the Council

Noqw Jew‐sinom put hihta neveltotoynayaqat pam pas suyan navotniqey nāwaknaqe, qavoṅvaqw put ṅāha; nihqe God awwat mohpeq momṅwit sohsokmuy moṅwtsovawtaqamuy amumum tsovaltiniqat pam paṅqawu; nit Paul hawnaqe, put pumuy amutpipo tavi.
